# Unsigned vectors have no Neg, so unary - on any unsigned type is not rewritten.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func NegUint8s(dst, a []uint8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = -a[i]
	}
}

func NegUint16s(dst, a []uint16) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = -a[i]
	}
}

func NegUint32s(dst, a []uint32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = -a[i]
	}
}

func NegUint64s(dst, a []uint64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = -a[i]
	}
}
